purpose: Build a need-specific pool of detailed specialist working profiles, use contextual finalist-vote history to form best/middle/lowest-third/mixed and broad combination teams, issue isolated parallel challenge packets, rank only supplied independent judgements, show the top two, and persist an explicit +1 fit vote for every member of the chosen finalist team.

properties.operation: prepare/build-pool, rank/select-finalists, record-vote, or inspect-fit; defaults to prepare
properties.challenge: prepare/inspect-fit: concrete challenge or need to inspect from many perspectives
properties.criteria: prepare: optional weighted judging criteria; defaults to evidence/correctness/gap discovery/feasibility/simplicity/consequence awareness
properties.max_teams: prepare: 4..512 generated teams; dedicated best/middle/lowest-third/mixed teams are preserved before combination sampling
properties.seed: prepare: optional deterministic RNG seed for the mixed-random team and combination sampling
properties.judgements: rank: independent evidence-backed criterion scores keyed by team_id
properties.ranking: record-vote: exact digest-bound complete ranking with two shown finalists
properties.winner_team_id: record-vote: explicit choice of one of the two shown finalists

contains: detailed universal and need-derived specialist profiles
two shown finalists when all teams are judged
explicit finalist vote receipt and +1 winning-member updates

relationships: turns the existing specialist-profile and specialist-summoner anatomy into a real local orchestration surface rather than pretending detached personalities are independent agents
universal perspective profiles are combined with challenge-matched master-registry specialists so the pool changes with the actual need
historical +1 votes are contextual fit evidence: a specialist can become highly ranked for one domain while remaining unproven elsewhere
best, middle, lowest-third and mixed-random teams remain present so accumulated winners are challenged by underexposed and differently composed teams
broad deterministic combination sampling explores as much of the team space as the explicit max_teams bound allows
team challenge packets are isolated from one another until judging so parallel competition does not leak the leading answer between teams
the engine never claims a team reasoned merely because a packet exists; a cognition provider, human, or other executor must actually produce the submission/evidence
only a complete independently judged field can expose two finalists, and only a separate finalist vote changes persistent fit history

anatomy_refs.basis: The live capability summons a bounded need-specific specialist pool, forms many team combinations, issues isolated challenge packets, and returns evidence-bearing tournament state.
Every specialist is an inspectable bounded working profile with explicit temperament, strengths, blind spots, evidence preference, disagreement style, and domain focus.

limitations: specialist personalities are method overlays, not independent identities, consciousness, expertise proof, or execution authority
the deterministic engine prepares and scores tournament structure but does not fake arbitrary reasoning; actual team submissions require an executor
+1 votes estimate observed contextual team fit and can be biased by exposure or judging quality; zero points can mean untested rather than bad
combination exploration is bounded to 512 teams per tournament and may sample rather than enumerate the full combinatorial space
historical votes influence future team construction but do not modify CANON, permissions, self-growth goals, or specialist authority
persistent_state: explicit finalist votes accumulate in state/specialist-fit.json; the ledger stores contextual/global points, tournament exposure, finalist exposure, and duplicate-safe vote receipts

truth.basis: The capability distinguishes prepared perspective packets from actual reasoning, requires evidence-backed supplied judgements, exposes incomplete judging, and records exactly which finalist vote created each +1.

agency.basis: No historical winner becomes permanent authority; middle, low, mixed and combination teams continue to challenge the currently best-fit specialists, and the final top-two choice remains an explicit vote.

continuity.basis: Fit history persists as an inspectable local ledger while specialist definitions remain reconstructable from the live source and master registry.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Many independent perspectives are explored before a finalist vote, while the team-space bound and explicit judging evidence prevent combinatorial exploration from being mistaken for knowledge.
